Lucid produced 2,954 vehicles and delivered 3,806 vehicles during the third quarter of 2026.¹ Deliveries exceeded production as the company continued to execute its planned inventory reduction, converting existing vehicle inventory into customer deliveries as part of the previously announced operating reset targeting $1.4 billion of cash flow improvements in 2026. Demand for the Lucid Gravity continued to regain momentum. As part of its operating reset, Lucid continued to align production with near-term demand. Production declined sequentially, consistent with the previously announced elimination of a second shift at AMP-1 in June, while deliveries were above production as the company reduced existing vehicle inventory. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Lucid will host a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a progress update on its key priorities on November 9, 2026. Conference Call Details Date: Monday, November 9, 2026 Time: 2:30 pm PT / 5:30 pm ET Webcast: https://ir.lucidmotors.com (live and replay) Prior to the conference call, the company will issue an earnings press release with a link to the live webcast on its investor relations website, https://ir.lucidmotors.com .
